Class ComboBoxItem<T>

java.lang.Object
be.henallux.project.view.ComboBoxItem<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the type of the object associated with this item
public class ComboBoxItem<T> extends Object
Represents a generic item to be used in JCombobox, where each item has an associated object and a displayable label. This class is reusable for every object

    • selectComboItem

      public static <T> void selectComboItem(JComboBox<ComboBoxItem<T>> combo, T object)
      Selects an item in the combo box that matches the given object. If the object is found, it becomes the selected item. Otherwise, nothing changes.
      Type Parameters:
      T - the type of the object
      Parameters:
      combo - the combo box
      object - the object to select
